Name: Fortune Bait
Author: secsky3
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Fortune Bait is an immersive late-game gold-sink mod for Stardew Valley that removes RNG from the fishing experience. By commissioning custom, species-specific bait from Willy's Fish Shop, you guarantee a 100% bite rate for your chosen fish—provided standard habitat requirements (location, season, time, and weather) are met. It eliminates trash and unwanted by-catches while keeping vanilla minigame mechanics, fish sizing, and quality progression intact.
[b]Installation instructions[/b]
[list]
[*]Install the latest versions of [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Stardew Valley (1.6+)[/b].[/*]
[*]Download the [b]Fortune Bait[/b] mod archive.[/*]
[*]Extract the folder directly into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[*][i](Optional)[/i] Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] to adjust prices, material requirements, and gold-only purchasing options directly in-game.[/*]
[/list][b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]100% Guaranteed Catch:[/b] Casting with a designated Fortune Bait guarantees that only the selected fish hooks the line. Seaweed, algae, junk, and off-target fish are completely bypassed.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Waste Prevention (Anti-Wasting):[/b] Prevents bait loss by blocking the cast and displaying an on-screen warning if current environmental conditions (location, time, season, weather) do not allow the target fish to spawn.[/*]
[*][b]Habitat Condition Tooltips:[/b] Detailed in-game tooltips display spawn locations, active seasons, exact hours, required weather, and minimum fishing levels.[/*]
[*][b]Willy's Workshop Interface:[/b] A dedicated shop UI featuring filtering tabs: [b][Available Now][/b] (currently catchable), [b][Unavailable][/b] (inactive due to season/time/weather), and [b][Show All][/b].[/*]
[*][b]Dedicated Trash Bait:[/b] A specialized bait option designed to hook 100% trash without triggering the fishing minigame, streamlining Linus's cleanup quest and recycling setups.[/*]
[*][b]Balanced Late-Game Pricing:[/b] Tiered scaling ranging from 1,000g for common fish up to 500,000g+ and Prismatic Shards for Legendary fish (fully customizable via GMCM).[/*]
[*][b]Cross-Mod Compatibility:[/b] Fully compatible with [b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/b] fish and locations, complete with full English and Korean localization.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b] (v1.6 or higher)[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] (v4.0 or higher)[/*]
[*][i](Optional)[/i] [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] for editing economy parameters and toggling material requirements.[/*]
[/list]
